name: Shoaib Khan
headline: Senior Manager @ Databricks
summary: Love building great products, highly effective teams and doing great things!

positions.title: Senior Manager Professional Services
positions.description: I lead GTM for Databricks’ Professional Services team in Central EMEA, driving high-impact data and AI solutions across Germany, Switzerland, Austria, and Eastern Europe. Our team specializes in first-of-a-kind, complex projects that make a real difference for our customers. We focus on driving innovation, ensuring flawless execution, and delivering measurable results through the Databricks Lakehouse Platform and our Professional Services portfolio.

positions.title: Senior Engagement Manager
positions.description: As a Senior Engagement Manager, I led Databricks’ Professional Services business in Germany & Switzerland, focusing on strategic and enterprise clients. I managed large-scale, transformative projects, ensuring successful delivery of data and AI solutions while driving meaningful business outcomes for our customers.

positions.title: Senior IT Project Manager @BI & BigData
positions.description: As a Senior Project Manager, I led the planning, staffing, financials, and delivery oversight for the Catastrophe Target Architecture program, one of the largest NatCat initiatives. I was responsible for ensuring successful execution, maintaining alignment with the customer, and being part of the higher management SteerCo to drive strategic goals.

positions.title: IT Project Manager
positions.description: As a Project Manager, I was responsible for leading the CAT Services & CAT UI sub-components of the Catastrophe Target Architecture program. I oversaw the planning and execution of this critical segment, ensuring alignment with overall program objectives and contributing to the success of one of the largest NatCat initiatives.

positions.title: Global Graduate Program - BI & BigData
positions.description: As a Global Graduate Trainee at Allianz, I gained broad international experience by working across various business units in Munich and Bangkok. I collaborated with the Oracle ExaData and Cloudera teams in Germany and the business analysts team in Thailand. This program, aimed at developing future leaders, gave me valuable exposure to Allianz’s global operations and cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Master Thesis Student
positions.description: As a Master’s Thesis Student at Allianz SE, I applied process mining techniques to optimize the Solvency II Closing Process. My work focused on identifying inefficiencies in the process, analyzing event logs, and providing recommendations for process improvements. This research contributed to exploring the use of process mining across the insurance value chain to enhance operational efficiency.
